question: Should gogcli support `drive upload --replace --if-version` by retaining a narrowly scoped Drive v2 dependency for ETag-based conditional writes?
rationale: The implementation is a new public CLI mode and deliberately depends on an older Drive API surface; tests and live proof establish behavior but cannot decide the repository's long-term API-support policy.

options.title: Accept the isolated Drive v2 path
options.body: Merge the opt-in conditional mode, keep unconditional replacement on Drive v3, and document that conditional calls fail closed when v2 preconditions cannot be obtained.

options.title: Require a v3-only design
options.body: Decline the Drive v2 dependency and wait for a conditional-write design that remains entirely on the supported Drive v3 client surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the isolated Drive v2 path
recommendation.body: Merge the opt-in conditional mode, keep unconditional replacement on Drive v3, and document that conditional calls fail closed when v2 preconditions cannot be obtained.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice affects the repository's public Drive command contract and its supported Google API boundary.
